title: The leadership group want a say on selection
text: They're not asking to pick the side. They want to be in the room.

choices.label: Bring them in each week
choices.result: The leaders are in the selection meeting.

title: {name} wants to take the young players for a session
text: Skills, standards, how to go about it. His way.

effects.why: You let him lead the young group

title: Two players were late to the team meeting
text: Not the first time this year. The group's waiting to see what you do.

choices.label: Make an example of them
choices.result: The pair train on their own on Sunday.

choices.label: Handle it quietly
choices.result: A quiet word, and it's done.

title: The players have called their own meeting
text: After the losing run, the senior players want the coaches out of the room.

choices.label: Let them have the room
choices.result: The players meet alone. They come out talking.

choices.label: The coaches stay in
choices.result: The coaches stay. The meeting is short.

title: {name} spoke up in the review
text: He questioned the game plan in front of the whole group.

choices.label: Back him for speaking up

effects.why: You backed him for speaking up in the review

choices.result: You back {name} in front of everyone. A few of the older heads bristle.

choices.label: Pull him up afterwards

effects.why: You pulled him up for questioning the game plan

choices.result: You have a word with {name} after the meeting.
